name: Austria
notes: Austrian lift passes are typical 6-day prices. Austrian resorts fill up in German and Dutch school holidays, as well as UK ones.

locations.name: St Anton
locations.character: Legendary Arlberg village with steep skiing, big off-piste and Austria's liveliest après-ski.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Innsbruck. Railjet trains stop in the village.

links.note: Ski across via the Flexenbahn to Zürs and Lech

park.note: A proper park on the Rendl with lines for each level.

expert.note: Steep runs, huge off-piste and ski routes across the Arlberg.

locations.name: Lech
locations.snowNote: One of the snowiest spots in the Alps, on the Arlberg's northern side.
locations.character: Smart, snowy village with chalet hotels and the White Ring circuit. Quiet, polished and expensive.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h45 from Innsbruck. Train to Langen, then the bus.

links.note: Ski across via the Flexenbahn to St Anton

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

expert.note: Big off-piste and ski routes across the Arlberg.

locations.name: Ischgl
locations.snowNote: Skiing mostly above 2,000 m keeps snow late.
locations.character: Party village with big-name concerts, high skiing and a duty-free link to Samnaun in Switzerland.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Innsbruck. Train to Landeck, then the bus.

park.note: A proper park at Idalp with lines for each level.

expert.note: High, open off-piste on the Swiss border.

locations.name: Sölden
locations.snowNote: Two glaciers above 3,000 m keep snow all season.
locations.character: Long, lively valley town with two glaciers above it and the James Bond restaurant on the Gaislachkogl.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Innsbruck.

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

expert.note: Glacier off-piste and long, steep runs.

locations.name: Obergurgl
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes beside the village hotels.
locations.snowNote: One of the highest villages in Austria, snow-sure from November.
locations.character: High, quiet village at the end of the Ötztal, snow-sure and ski-in ski-out. Popular with families.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h50 from Innsbruck.

expert.note: Some off-piste on the high slopes.

locations.name: Mayrhofen
locations.character: Busy Zillertal town with a famous park and the Harakiri, Austria's steepest groomed run.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h from Innsbruck. Train via Jenbach on the Zillertal railway.

park.note: The Penken park is one of the best in Europe, with lines for every level.

expert.note: The steep Harakiri and some off-piste.

locations.name: Kitzbühel
locations.character: Smart medieval town with the Hahnenkamm race course and a big, varied ski area.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Salzburg or 1h30 from Innsbruck. Trains to the town.

expert.note: The Streif downhill and some off-piste.

locations.name: Saalbach
locations.character: Lively, car-free village centre with a huge ski circus on both sides of the valley.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Salzburg.

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

locations.name: Zell am See
locations.snowNote: The Kitzsteinhorn glacier nearby keeps snow when the town slopes thin.
locations.character: Lakeside town with skiing on the Schmittenhöhe and the Kitzsteinhorn glacier at Kaprun close by.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Salzburg. Trains to the town.

park.note: A proper park, with the bigger Kitzsteinhorn parks a short bus ride away.

locations.name: Bad Gastein
locations.character: Belle Époque spa town on a waterfall, with thermal baths and good off-piste at Sportgastein.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Salzburg. Trains to the town.

locations.name: Obertauern
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes in the middle of the village.
locations.snowNote: A snow trap on a high pass, one of the snowiest resorts in Austria.
locations.character: High pass village where the lifts circle the resort. Famous for its snow and its après-ski.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Salzburg.

park.note: A proper park with lines for beginners and improvers.

locations.name: Schladming
locations.character: Lively old market town with four linked mountains and World Cup night races.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Salzburg. Trains to the town.

park.note: Small parks on the four mountains.

expert.note: Steep World Cup runs and some off-piste.

locations.name: Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis
locations.easyStart: Bertas Kinderland ski area at the bottom of the village, reached by the village underground.
locations.character: Car-free village on a sunny plateau, famous for its children's areas and kids' clubs.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Innsbruck.

park.note: A proper park with lines for beginners and improvers.

locations.name: Ellmau
locations.easyStart: Nursery slope beside the village, a short walk from most hotels.
locations.character: Pretty village under the Wilder Kaiser cliffs in one of Austria's biggest linked areas. Gentle and easy.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Salzburg or Innsbruck.

locations.name: Alpbach
locations.character: Often called Austria's prettiest village, all dark wood and flower boxes. Calm and family-friendly.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 50 min from Innsbruck.

locations.name: Hintertux
locations.snowNote: Glacier skiing up to 3,250 m, open all year.
locations.character: Small village below the Hintertux glacier, open for skiing all year round.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Innsbruck.

park.note: A well-known glacier park with lines for each level.

locations.name: Landeck
locations.character: Valley town with a castle, where the roads and trains to the Arlberg, Ischgl and Serfaus split.
locations.transfer: Train from Innsbruck about 50 min. Car 1h.

locations.name: Imst
locations.character: Market town at the mouth of the Ötztal, with lower prices than the resorts above.
locations.transfer: Train from Innsbruck about 40 min. Car 45 min.

locations.name: Innsbruck
locations.character: Alpine city with an old town, real nightlife and an airport on the edge of town.
locations.transfer: Bus or taxi from Innsbruck Airport about 15 min.

locations.name: Zell am Ziller
locations.character: Small Zillertal town with its own ski area, cheaper than Mayrhofen just up the valley.
locations.transfer: Train from Innsbruck about 1h. Car 50 min.

locations.name: Kirchberg in Tirol
locations.character: Lively village next door to Kitzbühel, sharing its ski area at lower prices.
locations.transfer: Train from Innsbruck about 1h15. Car 1h10.

links.note: Lifts straight into the KitzSki area

locations.name: Bruck
locations.character: Quiet village between Zell am See and Kaprun, with lower prices.
locations.transfer: Train from Salzburg about 1h20. Car 1h10.

locations.name: Bischofshofen
locations.character: Rail junction town in the Salzach valley, home of the New Year ski jump.
locations.transfer: Train from Salzburg about 45 min. Car 45 min.
